BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

6. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
